notes.title: SCUFFED BHOP 2023 Version 7.3 out for Windows, MacOS, and Linux (real)
notes.content:
[h1]LTS Version 7.3 is out[/h1]

Hello hello scuffed bhoppers of the 2023 era.
There's a update for [u][b]*NEW* SCUFFED EPIC BHOP SIMULATOR 2023 (POG CHAMP)[/b][/u]

The updates includes the following
[list]
[*] *NEW* SCUFFED BHOP SIMULATION 2026 GOTY EDITION OST added to the Music List
[*] Scuffed Visual Novel OST added to the Music List
[*] Performance updates regarding VRAM usage
[*] Reduce build size by 40~%!
[*] Fixed velocity on "Glass Bridge" on death
[*] MacOS & Linux builds fixed
[/list]


[i][u]Now for some more important news...[/u][/i]
[h1]Where have we've been?[/h1]

Surprisingly, most of us have recently started college/university and life has gotten in the way as the pandemic thing started to fade away. We are currently too busy at the moment to be going at it at Unity,

despite all this, we are still not out of the game. We have been making progress on our upcoming titles 
albeit, a bit slower then we wanted.

Needless to say, we are still going at making scuffed games despite us being at school and our full time jobs.

[h2]Thanks.[/h2]
[h3]Scuffed Development Team.[/h3]

notes.title: Version 7 Patch Notes
notes.content:
V7 Patch Notes

This will be the last MAJOR update for *NEW* SCUFFED EPIC BHOP SIMULATOR 2023 (POG CHAMP), if you wish to read more about this decision read this blog post

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1465860/view/3119302506887597138

Now, we have quite a few things to touch on that we have introduced in V7

Mod Menu
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076289/7ed2dde5f4ccac50f9ba27f60384ddda7c28e1ac.png[/img]

Behold, the Mod Menu,

This Menu allows you to change values such as Speed, Gravity, Jump Force and your Bean Size. We have been testing this feature for a solid while now and we are confident that this feature will be the creation of a lot of funny moments when you tinker around with some of these settings.

Whether you want to make your bean microscopic, apply Zero Gravity, become a giant and break the map, or become a speed demon, the possibilities are endless with the Mod Menu, which is all available to use for free upon the release of V7

The Mod Menu has only one limitation, that levels that encompass certain mechanics such as the grappling hook and the sliding mechanics will NOT support the Mod Menu, only classic Bhop Maps will support this feature.

If you wonder how speedruns will ever be viable after this Mod Menu is introduced, don’t worry, we have several ways to detect the mods being in use and this shouldn’t be an issue if any of you are worried about it

NEW MAPS + MECHANICS

New in this update is…..
Wall Running!
I bet a bunch of you saw this coming a mile away but we have added 2 new levels that encompass this new feature* (*Singleplayer levels only)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076289/3db23669c47dd1b753a6a0e955a401bd77d1bba0.png[/img]

Wiped
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076289/0f2e9b13f9c0dec8c1b6372337ad63c2b97b4e93.png[/img]


More

Thanks for supporting the development of Scuffed Bhop Simulator, or *NEW* SCUFFED EPIC BHOP SIMULATOR 2023 (POG CHAMP), it’s been a great ride and we hope to see you all return next year for *NEW* SCUFFED BHOP SIMULATION 2026 GAME OF THE YEAR EDITION (POG CHAMP) which launches Early Access in JANUARY.

Take Care and Happy New Year
Shanaz

notes.title: The End of *NEW* SCUFFED EPIC BHOP SIMULATOR 2023 (POG CHAMP)
notes.content:
Hello all Scuffed Beans,

It pains me to write this message, but on December 14th *NEW* SCUFFED EPIC BHOP SIMULATOR 2023 (POG CHAMP) will be receiving it's last content update, V7.

With this update we will see the Season Pass receive more maps, and a few more QOL changes as well as all major bugs from v6 fixed. After V7 gets released on the 14th, that will be the last ever [b]content[/b] update for *NEW* SCUFFED EPIC BHOP SIMULATOR 2023 (POG CHAMP).

Is this the end for the Scuffed Bhop franchise? 

....

NO!
Of course not! A while ago we revealed we were working on a *NEW* entry in the Scuffed Bhop franchise!

Introducing *NEW* SCUFFED BHOP SIMULATION 2026 GAME OF THE YEAR EDITION (POG CHAMP),
which we haven't revealed much information on yet.

We just released a gameplay teaser trailer which you can watch here!
[previewyoutube=52fgJORKX3c;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

The store page will be up in a few days! We will be launching early access (paid) for *NEW* SCUFFED BHOP SIMULATION 2026 GAME OF THE YEAR EDITION (POG CHAMP) in January for those who are dying to play the game

Of course, I am not the most fond of a pay to play system, the FULL GAME will be releasing in March of 2022, but the option to receive early access will be there who are willing to pay 99 cents.

That's all for todays announcement!
Make sure to look for Scuffed Party and Version 7 which both release on the 14th of December!

Stay Scuffed
- Shanaz

notes.title: VERSION 4 UPDATE
notes.content:
Hey Guys, it's been a while, Today I will be revealing the patch notes of V4 for *NEW* SCUFFED EPIC BHOP SIMULATOR 2023 (POG CHAMP)

[i][u][b]NEW MODE[/b][/u][/i]
SURF
- 5 MAPS
2 Are being revealed in our discord!! (https://discord.gg/7A5UcFBEmg)
Surf is a mode where instead of jumping you will find yourself sliding.
We have been working closely with RiadZX who is the creator of the game BSurfing, if you haven't seen it yet, you can check out their discord here https://discord.gg/9VCh85bwYW

*NEW* CONTENT
Knife Selector
- There will be knife skins for free and part of the season pass!

Bhop Maps
- We are working on 2 *NEW* Maps for Free to Play players
- Our next round of season pass maps are releasing April 15th

NEW GAME
For those who didn't see on our *NEW* Scuffed Community Broadcast, we are developing a new game! It is titled *NEW* SCUFFED EPIC VISUAL NOVEL, and will reveal more backstory around the game and a brand new feel to the franchise.
- Steam store page is awaiting review and we will let you all know once it's ready to wishlist

ZOMBIES MODE
- Scheduled release date is TBC
- Version 5 will most likely include this mode with Pog Church as one of the maps, this map will be added to the base game reasonably soon as a bhop map.

There is a *NEW* Secret, and here are some clues
- The way to access this secret is by touching a certain object
- This object was originally speculated about in V1 (the original release)
That's all I'm telling you for now,

That's it for now, I will be revamping the Library and Store assets for the game in the coming days. When will this update release you ask? We are aiming for Friday/Saturday release, we originally hoped to release the update Friday at 8pm AWST (my local time zone), but depending on how quickly we can finish up all of the content and playtest it we might have to delay it to Saturday 8pm AWST or Sunday if all goes wrong. Updates will be on our discord server

Thanks for being patient with us and we hope to see a new record of players when this update releases! That's it from the Scuffed Development Team (yes we have a team working on this game now)
- Shanaz

notes.title: v1.1 Update!
notes.content:
Hey guys! It hasnt even been 24 hours since i released this game onto steam. But I am happy to release version 1.1 of the game!

[b]NEW MAP | BEACH[/b]
The new beach map involves jumping over grass and sand!
Thats pretty much it...

[b]MENU UPDATES[/b]
You will now see a preview of the map before playing it with the new menu. Which has been scaled to 1920x1080, if you have trouble with the resolution please let me know!

[b]MAC SUPPORT[/b]
To All mac users! The game is coming out for Mac later today! If it doesnt work, please stay tuned, as it is very experimental at the moment, but please stay with me!

Thanks Everyone
See you all next week

Shanaz
